contract.words: I need to keep $3,000 after costs, settled within 14 days. No starting capital.

terms.proofCondition: No starting capital: costs must be paid from buyer money already received; only settled cash within 14 days counts

strategy.title: No plan: no opening can be shown to settle $3,000 of contribution in 14 days with zero capital
strategy.why: Brain holds no target for this goal and refuses every route, so no opening could be recorded or calculated. On the public evidence, settlement itself is the binding link for a new seller: Stripe schedules a new account's first payout 7-14 days after the first live payment, PayPal holds a new seller's service payments until 7 days after completion (up to 21 days), Fiverr clears earnings 14 days after completion and Upwork holds fixed-price payments 5 days after approval (clients have 14 days to approve). A sale would have to be closed, delivered and approved inside the first week, with no money for tools or a subcontractor until a buyer pays.

alternatives.title: Bid on posted website projects on Freelancer.com
alternatives.why: 348 open website-design jobs on 2026-11-27, but average bids $25-$656 against 100-400 rival bids and a 10%/$5 fee; 6+ wins delivered and released inside 14 days from a new account is not evidenced.

alternatives.title: Fiverr website gig
alternatives.why: Fiverr's 14-day clearing period after completion puts every dollar outside a 14-day window.

alternatives.title: Cold-emailed website redesign with card deposit
alternatives.why: Needs a paid sending tool before any buyer pays (capital 0), and Stripe's 7-14 day first payout makes even a day-1 deposit settle at the window's edge; price and close rate unknown.

noPlan.decisiveGap: Settlement in time for a brand-new seller with no capital: no route has a payment path shown to put buyer money in the owner's account within 14 days (Stripe first payout 7-14 days, PayPal 7-21 day holds, Fiverr 14-day clearing, Upwork 5-day hold after up to 14-day approval), and no buyer, price or close rate is established.
noPlan.resolution: Zero-cost test: on day 1-3 bid on 20 posted fixed-price Freelancer.com website jobs whose clients fund milestones in escrow; PROOF: 3 funded milestones totalling >= $1,200 by day 4 and the first released and withdrawn by day 10; STOP: no funded milestone by day 4, or first release not withdrawable by day 10 -> the window cannot be met, ask the owner to relax the deadline to 30 days; CONTINUE: 1-2 funded milestones -> keep bidding through day 5 only.
